reason: A DeepSeek Harness settings panel for browsing installed plugins, toggling their enabled state, editing local notes, and managing configuration backups.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的设置页面提供插件目录、启停控制、备注编辑以及本地配置备份管理功能。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness settings panel for browsing plugins, toggling their enabled state, editing local notes, and managing local configuration backups.

capabilities: Adds a Plugin Manager tab under Settings → Plugins
Enables or disables plugin rows by editing the global cordis.patch.yml file
Edits and stores per-plugin names and descriptions in a local catalog.json file
Exports and imports local plugin configuration backups
